accuracyFlags: Section 06 'Do not drive between dusk and dawn in rural Australia if you can avoid it' and FAQ 'accept the hit rather than swerving' are advice stated flatly; official state sources linked are fatigue-only, none for wildlife strikes.
'Plan the itinerary so no day requires more than about four hours of driving' contradicts the page's own sibling routes (Adelaide to Uluru is four days each way).
